# firebaseappdistribution Provider

Manage [Firebase App Distribution](https://firebase.google.com/docs/app-distribution) tester groups and group memberships through the [App Distribution REST API](https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/app-distribution/rest).

Authentication follows the usual Google Cloud conventions. Unless `access_token` is set, [Application Default Credentials](https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/application-default-credentials) are used, which covers `gcloud auth application-default login`, the `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` environment variable and Workload Identity Federation in CI.

Projects can be referenced by ID or by number. IDs are resolved to numbers through the [Firebase Management API](https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/firebase-management/rest), which must be enabled on the project. The identity needs `firebase.projects.get` plus the `firebaseappdistro.groups.*` and `firebaseappdistro.testers.*` permissions; the predefined roles `roles/firebase.viewer` and `roles/firebaseappdistro.admin` together grant them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    firebaseappdistribution = {
      source  = "cut0/firebaseappdistribution"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "firebaseappdistribution" {
  project = "my-firebase-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) A temporary OAuth 2.0 access token obtained from the Google Authorization server. Can also be set with the `GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable. When set, Application Default Credentials are not used.
- `billing_project` (String) Project used for quota and billing (sent as `x-goog-user-project`). Needed when the identity belongs to a different project than the one being managed. Can also be set with the `GOOGLE_BILLING_PROJECT` environment variable.
- `impersonate_service_account` (String) Email of a service account to impersonate for all API calls. The base identity needs `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` on it. Can also be set with the `GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` environment variable.
- `project` (String) Default Firebase project ID or number used by resources that do not set `project`. Can also be set with the `FIREBASE_PROJECT` or `GOOGLE_PROJECT` environment variable.
